# ASTROJAK

> 1:1 online Vedic astrology consultation platform led by Acharya Narender Ji. Offering Janam Kundali Analysis, Marriage Matchmaking (Kundli Milan), and practical Vedic remedies (upay) over private phone call and WhatsApp.

## About ASTROJAK & Astrologer
- [ASTROJAK Online Consultation](https://www.astrojak.in/): Book Vedic astrology consultations online starting from ₹299.
- [Acharya Narender Ji Overview](https://www.astrojak.in/home): Senior Vedic Astrologer with 20+ years of experience, 1,000+ consultations, and a 4.8/5 client rating. Specializes in birth chart reading, marriage compatibility, career timing, and Vedic remedies.

## Consultation Plans & Pricing
- **Quick Clarity (Reserve Your Slot)**: ₹299 — A 1:1 call with an astrologer to discuss one question of your choice, plus a detailed personal horoscope PDF report.
- **Kundali Analysis**: ₹999 — 30-minute birth chart consultation.
- **Detailed Kundali Analysis**: ₹1,499 — 60-minute comprehensive birth chart consultation covering Mahadasha, Antardasha timing, planetary transits, and customized Vedic remedies.
- **Marriage Matchmaking Analysis (Kundli Milan)**: ₹1,999 — Two Kundlis compared for marriage compatibility, including two follow-up consultations; book one appointment.
- **5-Year Roadmap**: ₹2,999 — Includes two follow-up calls; book one appointment.

## Key Features & Policies
- **No Per-Minute Pressure**: Flat fee per consultation tier with dedicated time.
- **Privacy & Confidentiality**: Customer names, birth details, and consultation discussions are kept 100% private.
- **Payment Security**: Secure checkout powered by Razorpay (UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards).
- **Refund Policy**: Clear refund policy published online before consultation begins.
